output.name: Part search misses existing parts, causing duplicate part creation
output.summary: Engineers searching by description either get no results or hundreds of hits for common parts like M8 bolts and brackets, so they cannot find existing parts and sometimes create duplicates.

root_cause.text: Likely the default description-based part search is unreliable (inconsistent descriptions, no relevance filtering), while the classification search that does find parts is not what users reach for by default.

quotes.quote: Showed classification search; existing part found.

evidence.text: Every ticket was resolved the same way, by showing the user classification search, after which the existing part was found.

quotes.quote: Showed classification search; existing part found.
Showed classification search; existing part found.

evidence.text: Failed searches lead engineers to redraw parts that already exist, producing duplicates flagged by the data steward.

quotes.quote: Search did not find the bracket so I drew it again; data steward says it is a duplicate.
Cannot find existing part, created a new one

evidence.text: Description search fails in both directions: no results for specific parts and too many results for common fasteners.

quotes.quote: Search returns nothing for hex bolt M8
Is there an existing part for a stainless M8 bolt? Search returns hundreds.

output.fix: Make classification-based search the default entry point for part search and add a mandatory duplicate check (classification/attribute similarity match) in the new-part creation workflow so users are shown likely existing parts before a new part number can be created.
